status: contract published before implementation; build-plan annex only
context: with Campaign(...) as campaign: ...; pure stdlib, no model imports; entry and exit pins/HALTED checks; exceptions propagate Refusal for analyzer terminal boundary

methods.battery(): contract.Battery; exactly 4 x 500 contract.Pair; raw feasibility words mapped to unscrambling
methods.predictor_data(): dict[predictor][family] = (tuple[Pair,...], tuple[scoring.Score,...]); includes pythia_1b, olmo2_1b, twin; complete raw validated/re-scored first
methods.predictor_draws(): dict[predictor][family] = tuple[tuple[tuple[str,...],...],...]; axes pair, ARMS, draws; twin key as above
methods.outcomes(): dict[family] = tuple[dict,...]; each dict is exact scoring.outcome_counts output (bits,joint,sham,y,y_sham,first_index,first_order_score,later_losses,joint_agreement); exact GRID x ARMS raw rederived; calls verify_complete
methods.outcome_draws(): dict[family] = tuple[tuple[tuple[str,...],...],...]; axes pair, GRID, ARMS
methods.baselines(): dict[method][family] = tuple[scoring.Score,...] or None for nonapplicable; deterministic k1
methods.verify_predictor_seal(): returns parsed exact rederived seal dict; verifies annotated predictor tag + all bound bytes; no statistical test
methods.verify_power(): returns ORIGINAL parsed exp7.statistics.v2 power record (Fraction objects still encoded); actual seal_sha256, battery_sha256 and source_bindings.code_manifest/source_manifest checked, immutable power hash + commit checked. Full finite-table semantic verification belongs stats author. power.path is configured to statistics/power/power.json in production
methods.verify_complete(): returns None; requires seal/power, all 26 candidate units, per-host two-loader full endpoint equality and old-anchor tolerances
methods.bindings(): dict[str,str]: trust_sha256,battery_sha256,source_manifest_sha256,code_manifest_sha256; administrative independent inputs, no hash of whatever output is present
methods.seal_bindings(): first verify_predictor_seal; returns {seal_sha256,battery_sha256,bindings:<real sealed file map>}
methods.power_bindings(): first verify_power; returns {power_sha256,record:<original parsed record>,bindings:<real power path/hash>}
methods.complete_payload(): producer inventory after verify_complete, schema exp7.complete.v1; secure/commit via complete_campaign before pinning it in next trust revision
methods.complete_bindings(): first verify_complete; rederives map and compares to independently pinned committed complete receipt, then returns {complete_sha256,bindings}; missing complete authority refuses
methods.baseline_draws(): dict[method][applicable_family] = tuple[dict[arm,str|None],500]; TRUE archived raw outputs, None abstentions preserved; no N/A families invented
methods.base_assignments(): dict[family] = tuple[stable canonical JSON base IDs,500], metadata-only merge_levels over certified nominal/ordinal values; 15/20/5/2 blocks
methods.require_preoutcome(): pure guard BEFORE power: forbids units/outcome, units/endpoint, units/outcome-anchors, outcomes, contacts/outcome, outcome load receipts and outcome claims; HALTED always refuses
methods.entryexit(stage): UNENTERED Campaign context manager for analysis|power|calibration. Stats must first create its exclusive statistics/{stage}/CLAIM.json. Collection then verifies and consumes the separate evidenced owner grant BEFORE entry pin/raw checks. Yields bindings(), NOT a fabricated stats verification receipt. Management StatsCampaignAdapter adds stats-facing provenance shape. Calibration uses exp7.build-grant.v1 before tag/projection; power/analysis use post-projection exp7.owner-grant.v1. Exit rechecks all pins/HALTED and, for power, actual outcome-contact inventory. Both once claims remain consumed on failure.

nonnegotiable: independent trust SHA is a caller freeze constant, never read from raw
all imports including init and executed aliases traced

entrypoints.build_tokenizer_gate: exp7core.preflight.build_tokenizer_checks(...): future authorized BUILD, BEFORE prereg; no weights

Existing power record schema was aligned by source read to exp7.statistics.v2; declarations entries have status, not bare status strings. No method computes actual selectivity p.
